tonight.headline: Ahead by 21, but Tuten limped off and Likely has nothing yet
body: Bad news first: Bhayshul Tuten, your FLEX, aggravated his foot/ankle on Jacksonville's first snap and limped off (NBC 21:38Z; Heavy 21:36Z). Rice, the alternative, finished with 11.3. Isaiah Likely was active but has 0.0 so far. Pickens (23.8) and Boswell (13) carried the early games.

ESPN projects 113.4 to 110.9, 53%. KEI returns have five players in JAX–NYG and Denver–Las Vegas (Lawrence, Washington, Little, Skattebo, Coleman) and the Vikings D/ST tonight. You have Wilson, Tuten and Likely in progress and Jayden Daniels on Monday. Nothing can be moved: Daniels is your only unlocked starter, and your bench is on bye, out or finished.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Lawrence, Washington and Little all play in the same Jacksonville game Tuten left. A Jaguars rally plus a quiet Likely, with Tuten out, flips a 53% game.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Daniels on Monday night is the last lever, and he is already starting.

worthALook.name: Justice Hill
worthALook.lead: Baltimore's lead back if Henry's concussion check holds — but a waiver claim costs you priority for the season.

case.label: The player
case.body: 17.6 points on 11 touches (archive). Henry left for an apparent concussion evaluation, and Hill 'will take over the backfield' (Yahoo 21:06Z).

case.label: The cost
case.body: He is on waivers, so a claim drops Bloodsports from 7th to last for the rest of the season (STRATEGY §4). Your RB seats behind Taylor and Gordon are Tuten (hurt today), Jacobs (iffy) and Marks (protocol).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Henry ruled out for more than a week and Tuten out for Week 12. Then Hill is a starter for you, the one case STRATEGY allows priority for.
